# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 24 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Death; The Tablets of Stone and Clay

---

**1** Eve lived to be nine hundred and forty years old. When she was dying, she gathered her children around her.

**2** She said to them: 'Listen to me, my children. I am going to tell you what has happened to me since the day your father and I were expelled from paradise, so you will know the truth.'

**3** She told them the whole story of the fall in paradise, from beginning to end. They wept with her and mourned deeply.

**4** Eve said: 'Have Seth write down all my words and your father's deeds — on tablets of stone and on tablets of clay. If God destroys the world by water, the stone tablets will survive. If by fire, the clay tablets will survive.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
